name: Elliot Friedman
description: Elliot is a smart contract security engineer and principal at Solidity Labs. Over seven years he has deployed 67 production contracts securing more than $2 billion in TVL, with zero losses. He built Forge Proposal Simulator, a governance security tool widely adopted across DeFi, and Kleidi, a timelock-based self-custody system built to defend against attacks that multisigs can't stop. A contributor to SEAL Frameworks, he writes and speaks on smart contract and governance security.
